title: Command utils
description: This mod adds a function where if you press a key, it generates the give command of the held item.
body:
## Command utils A simple client side mod which adds a function to generate a give command directly from a held item.
> There are 2 different keybinds for this mod, one directly copies the give command to your clipboard and the other sends a chat message. When this message is clicked it copies the message to your clipboard.
**Both of these keys can be set in the settings under controls.**
